clue.text: Lets off Semtex, violently seizing power

clue.text: Reject credit, accepting anything you can afford's settled up front?

definitions.text: Reject credit, accepting anything you can afford's settled up front?

explanation.definitionFit: Paying with money on the spot means refusing credit and buying only what is affordable, settled in advance.
